propFirms.name: FTMO
propFirms.ruleNotes: FTMO calculates maximum daily loss of 5% based on the previous day's midnight balance, including floating losses, commissions, and swaps.

propFirms.name: FundedNext
propFirms.ruleNotes: Stellar 2-Step features an 8% Phase 1 target with a 5% daily loss limit and a 15% profit share from the challenge phase.

propFirms.name: The5ers
propFirms.dailyResetRule: 00:00 Server Time (Higher of Equity or Balance)
propFirms.ruleNotes: The5ers resets daily pause levels using the higher of your account balance or floating equity at midnight server time. Holding winning trades past rollover raises your daily loss floor.

propFirms.name: Alpha Capital Group
propFirms.ruleNotes: Alpha Capital Group charges zero commission on standard accounts but enforces a stricter 4% daily drawdown and 8% maximum drawdown ceiling.

instruments.seoDescription: In MT4/MT5 prop firm feeds, 1 standard lot of XAUUSD equals 100 troy ounces of gold. A $1.00 price move (10 standard pips at 0.10 or 100 points at 0.01) equals $100.00 per 1.00 lot.
One standard lot of EURUSD is 100,000 currency units. Every 1-pip movement (0.0001) equals $10.00 per standard lot, $1.00 per mini lot (0.10), and $0.10 per micro lot (0.01).
Most CFD prop firms define 1 standard lot of NAS100 (US100) with a contract size of 1 or 10. Always verify whether a 1-point index move equals $1.00 or $10.00 on your broker's MT5 specification tab.
Because GBPJPY is quoted in Japanese Yen, 1 pip (0.01) equals 1,000 JPY per standard lot. Converted to a USD prop account at ~150 USDJPY, 1 pip equals approximately $6.67 per lot.
